messages:
Maria H: Heads-up — merging the weight bundle for token-bundle-v2. Before I merge, quick sanity check: S3 path + tokenizer behavior + config lint. Anyone free to eyeball? I've hit a tokenizer edge where leading U+00A0 isn't trimmed in a few samples.

Evan J: I can check weights path. Which one?

Maria H: s3://redwood-models/releases/token-bundle-v2/weights.tar.gz

Evan J: got it. Confirmed objects present, sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f6...; recommendation: use weights/_v2/ folder in serving config. Also note we had a permission edge for glue role — fixed.

Priya S: The tokenizer note — thanks. I reproduced the NBSP issue. Happens when tokenizer's strip_control=false in our vendored vocab. Quick patch: set strip_control=true in tokenizer config or add normalizer that maps U+00A0 -> space.

Sam R: config-lint output (CI):
```
serving_config.yaml: line 42: unknown field 'kv_cache_size_est'
tokenizer.json: warning: unknown property 'strip_control'
```
I think the schema updated; kv_cache_size_est should be under runtime.hints

Maria H: Hmm, so two things — tokenizer change and config move. Is that safe for prod? I want to avoid subtle generation diffs.

Priya S: If we toggle strip_control on, can run a quick regression eval on a small golden set (50 prompts). I'll run it on staging and post token-delta.

Evan J: Also, can we pin quantization params? Serving default is q4_0, but the weightbundle was exported with q4_1 metadata. Mismatch may cause perf regressions.

Maria H: Good call. Add to checklist: ensure quant_meta matches serving.runtime.quant

Priya S: Ran eval — 50 prompts, 2 regressions (formatting: missing trailing newline in structured replies). Token-delta median: +0.2 tokens, mean latency +3%. Details:
- prompt 13 -> model omits closing </json>
- prompt 47 -> tool call sequence order shuffled

Sam R: The linted schema change is why tool calling sequence differs — our tool-caller shim expects 'tools' array order. I've added a compatibility layer in the shim branch 'tool-compat/ordering-fix'. Can someone review small PR?

Maria H: @Sam R please add PR link. @Priya S thanks — can you paste the failing prompt examples? We need to see if it's tokenizer or tool shim.

Priya S: Paste examples:
```
Prompt 13: "Summarize the plan in JSON"
Expected: {"plan": [..], "closing":"\n"}
Actual: {"plan":[..],"closing":""}
```
Prompt 47: tool-calls: expected [search, extract] got [extract, search]

Sam R: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/934 — adds order-preserving tool dispatch and fallback to sorted tools for older bundles.

Evan J: I pushed updated serving_config.yaml with kv_cache_size moved to runtime.hints and quant = q4_1. I've drafted a small migration hook to translate older bundles.

Maria H: Awesome. Final ask: can we run a canary rollout on dedicated staging with these changes? Small traffic (1%), keep tracing on. I'll hold merge until green.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: service=token-bundle-staging, pct=1, start=2026-03-17T16:05:00Z

Priya S: Starting eval run on canary now, will post results in ~10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam R: Reviewing PR now :eyes:

Maria H: Thanks team. If all green I'll merge at EOD. :thumbsup:
